desc:
VANILLA CHIP GRANOLA BAR: Made with sweet vanilla chips and paired with rolled oats

NON-GMO: Certified organic non-GMO granola bars

DELICIOUS FLAVOR: Bite into a delicious vanilla chip granola bar

WHOLESOME INGREDIENTS: Contains 11 grams of whole grain per serving

CONTAINS: 7.4 oz
features:
Key Features:

No Added Sugar

Naturally sweetened with dates and dried blueberries for a wholesome taste without added sugar.

Whole-Grain Rich

Contains 27 grams of whole grain per serving—more than half of the recommended daily amount.

Certified Organic & Non-GMO

Made with USDA Organic ingredients and no genetically modified organisms.

Simple Ingredients

Includes organic whole grain oats, dates, blueberries, sunflower oil, and natural flavors.

Convenient Resealable Packaging

Easy to store and keeps contents fresh for longer.

Benefits:

Supports Digestive Health

The fiber from whole grains and fruits helps promote healthy digestion.

Sustained Energy

With complex carbohydrates and fiber, it provides steady energy without the sugar crash.

Naturally Delicious

Offers a naturally sweet flavor from real fruits without needing artificial sweeteners.

Versatile Use

Great as a cereal, yogurt topper, smoothie bowl ingredient, or on-the-go snack.

Conscious Choice

Choosing organic and no-sugar-added granola supports cleaner eating and sustainable farming practices.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats*, Tapioca Syrup*, Rice Flour*, Vanilla Chips* (cane sugar*, palm kernel oil*, sunflower lecithin*, vanilla extract*), Sunflower Oil*, Glycerin*, Cane Sugar*, Sea Salt, Raisin Juice Concentrate*, Baking Soda, Annatto* (for color). *Organic
